notes.title: Updates for June 22
notes.content:
Some bugs are fixed!!

- More control on the Space Suit, just press the Left click and your suite will balance if you are spinning without control, not anymore :D

- Menus (press "F") in all the levels

- Improvements on gameplay sound and graphics

Enjoy this new release streaming with your friends !
